      <div className="segmented" aria-label="Transaction type">
        {(["expense", "income", "refund"] as const).map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={type === t}
            onClick={() => {
              setType(t);
              setCategoryId(
                data.categories.find(
                  (c) => c.id === selections.current[t] && !c.archived,
                )?.id || chooseCategory(t),
              );
              setOriginalExpenseId("");
            }}
          >
            {t[0].toUpperCase() + t.slice(1)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <label
        className="amount-label"
        htmlFor={initial ? "edit-amount" : "amount"}
      >
        Amount <span>MXN</span>
      </label>
      <div className="amount-wrap">
        <span aria-hidden="true">$</span>
        <input
          ref={amountRef}
          id={initial ? "edit-amount" : "amount"}
          autoFocus={!initial}
          aria-label="Amount"
          inputMode="decimal"
          autoComplete="off"
          placeholder="0.00"
          value={amount}
          maxLength={12}
          onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </div>
